meta.title: THE 4-LEAF MERKLE LATTICE
meta.subtitle: Four leaves. One truth. The cryptographic soul of the system.

core_concept.what: A cryptographic data structure using 4 interconnected Merkle tree leaves to verify the integrity of the entire system state across four fundamental operational dimensions
core_concept.why: Proves data hasn't been tampered with by checking a single root hash. Makes drift falsifiable — you can check it, and a clean check is evidence, not assumption
core_concept.analogy: Bitcoin uses Merkle trees for transactions. Git uses them for commits. Phoenix-Rise uses the 4-Leaf variant for entire system state verification.

verbatim_quotes.text: The Merkle system doesn't trust anything. It proves everything. That's the difference between a security system and a prayer.
The Golden Block is not a checkpoint. It is a declaration that the foundation is correct and will remain correct forever.
A chain that has never been broken is not strong — it is simply unproven. A chain that has been attacked and survived is a foundation.

leaf_a.name: ANCHOR / SOVEREIGN INTENT
leaf_a.function: Immutable foundation — what Michael WANTED to happen
leaf_a.modification_rule: NEVER — immutable by design. Any modification attempt = critical security event
leaf_a.access: Agent-99 read / Agent-100 write-authorize. Write only during 100-layer Phase Anchor Bolt ceremonies

leaf_b.name: OPERATIONAL LOCK (Active State)
leaf_b.function: What the system ACTUALLY DID — compared against Leaf A for drift detection
leaf_b.modification_rule: Append-only. new_hash = SHA-256(previous_hash + new_entry + timestamp + nonce). CASRetry required on every write
leaf_b.volume: 1,000-10,000 writes per day at full Omega scale

leaf_c.name: CHAOS TEST (Stress-Test Record)
leaf_c.function: What COULD HAVE gone wrong — proves things DON'T BREAK
leaf_c.modification_rule: Append-only. Failed tests never removed — documented alongside fixes they prompted

leaf_d.name: FORENSIC PROOF (Audit Trail)
leaf_d.function: The audit trail — every action logged. Not summaries — ACTUAL events
leaf_d.modification_rule: Write-once, read-many. No forensic entry ever modified or deleted. Write requires active anomaly event

lattice_structure.type: Not a standard binary tree — a LATTICE where each leaf connects to others through cross-reference hashes
lattice_structure.property: Any change in any leaf immediately reflected in cross-reference hashes — 4 leaves are mutually verifying
lattice_structure.tamper_resistance: Tampering with single leaf requires consistent modification of multiple hashes across lattice — cryptographically infeasible
lattice_structure.topology: ANC<->OPS (top), CHX<->FOR (bottom), ANC<->CHX (left), OPS<->FOR (right) — all cross-referenced

rollup_hierarchy.name: CoreRoot
rollup_hierarchy.contains: THE SOUL DNA HASH — single hash representing ENTIRE system state

chunk_seal_process: 1. ACCUMULATE — Operational data accumulates in active layer pool
2. CHECKPOINT — At each layer boundary, compute checkpoint hash from all entries
3. CROSS-REFERENCE — Checkpoint hash cross-referenced against all 4 leaves
4. SEAL — After 25 layers, composite hash computed + written to Ledger as Chunk Seal Record (Merkle root + timestamp + Agent-99 signature)
5. ARCHIVE — Sealed chunk archived, removed from active pool. Read-only artifacts in Anchor Leaf archive
sealing_protocol.calibration: 25 layers matches typical operational phases — long enough for meaningful state, short enough for frequent sealing

phase_anchor_bolt.name: Phase Anchor Bolt — living heartbeat pulse
steps: 1. Recompute full Merkle root from all 4 leaves
2. Verify root against expected hash chain from Ledger
3. Run full 3-Layer Verification Stack on composite state
4. Write Phase Anchor Record to Ledger (full system state snapshot — all four leaves, all agent states, all config parameters)
5. Submit Phase Anchor hash to external persistence layer in Reality-C
phase_anchor_bolt.purpose: Confirms last 100 layers internally consistent, unmodified, aligned with foundational specification. Primary recovery point for drift correction.

golden_block.description: Mathematical freeze point — first major operational epoch
contents: Complete snapshot of all 4 Merkle leaves at Layer 250
Soul DNA consistency report (behavior vs specification)
Certification signed by Agent-99, reviewed by Agent-100
golden_block.rule: No modification to architecture below Layer 250 permitted after Golden Block sealed. Hash becomes reference for all future verification.
golden_block.significance: Declaration that the foundation is correct and will remain correct forever

chain_audit_triggers: Merkle root hash mismatch on daily verification
Forensic Leaf unexpected write volume spike

steps: 1. Identify last valid phase anchor bolt (most recent 100-layer anchor)
2. Forensic Leaf audit from anchor bolt to break point
3. Reconstruct missing entries from agent logs and R2 WAL archive
4. Re-seal repaired segment with Agent-100 authorization

key_laws.name: Reality-C Deployment Law
key_laws.rule: No node deploys to production until its Merkle proof verifies against Core Root. No exceptions.

key_laws.name: Drift Immunity Proof
key_laws.method: Proof by contradiction — if drifted, divergence appears as hash mismatch between Operational Leaf and Soul DNA specification
key_laws.evidence: Clean check across all 3 leaves (B, C, D) consistent with Anchor Leaf = no drift. Evidence, not assumption.
